question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank No. 3
solution:
The correct answer is **Option (3) i.e. 'abode'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Trees often serve as **a home or dwelling place for various birds and insects**, making '**abode**' the most fitting choice.
 
• 'Abode' signifies** a place of residence**, reflecting the sheltering aspect of trees for wildlife.
 
• The use of 'abode' underlines the concept of trees being a living space for numerous species.

**Therefore, the correct answer is 'abode'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **'Refuge'** means a condition of being safe or sheltered from pursuit, danger, or trouble.
 
• '**Terrain**' refers to a stretch of land, especially with regard to its physical features.
 
• '**Asylum**' usually denotes a place of shelter and safety, often used for protection provided to refugees.

Complete Passage is: Trees are one of the gifts of the nature which are of great importance__ for all living beings and environment. They have __ample__ benefits to living beings providing natural herbs, vegetables, fruits, wood, timber, etc. Trees are the __abode__ of many birds and insects. They are also considered as the ______ part of the atmosphere which help in reducing pollution. Conserving trees and spreading awareness to plant trees will save the atmosphere from depletion and ______ survival of all forms on earth.
